President Hussein, standing behind the Presidential Seal, proclaimed responsibility for the signal intrusion and transformed the threat from a warning to an ultimatum. Hussein asserted that unless the United Lavian Republic and Mizrahel relinquish control and release the land of Shamat from bondage, the strategic missile attacks would target objectives to restore justice by force. He asserted that all avenues of diplomacy were over and that resistance is an assault upon the Isaath people.

[quote=irakqaist;61081781]I have already looked, but what are the populations, GDP, and pixel limits? Also, where can I calculate how many pixels I have?[/quote]
For your first two expansions, since you are new, is 30k pixels (for 3k words). The reasonability of an increased GDP is determined by the Moderation Team, and if you don't have Paint.net, you can try googling a pixel calculator. In terms of population increase via expansion, generally 10-20 million is accepted, though it is up to whatever Cartographer who's doing the update to determine if it is reasonable or not, so you may get higher.

[b]July 25, 2027: The Irakqist blip[/b]

The question at hand is not whether the Irakqist state poses a threat to Mizrahel and The United Lavian Republics, but a question of WHEN they intend to strike, began general Menkin, addressing the PDC and triumvirate following dire reports of threats of violence by the president of the Irakqist state against the aforementioned states.

But why does this pertain to Rosenmarkke general? enquired consul Belgarde.

Because of our procurement order which we sent last month to the Lavian state for the Serval strike fighters, your honour, replied Menkin.

So what do you suggest Menkin, I believe intervention is completely out of the question, stated Strømm.

Yes, you would be correct madame consul, and the fact of the matter is, the Lavian state and the Mizraheli state are both superbly well equipped to fight the Irakqist government, replied Menkin.

So what? Why bother us with this? enquired Consantin.

Because, it has the chance to escalate, if we allow it, replied Menkin.

I am sorry, [i]if we allow it[/i] interjected Strømm, Are you saying the SCSID has a part in this, because if it is so, then I am going to have to shut you down there,

I do not mean that madame consul, I was not suggesting the SCSID has any involvement in the affairs of the Irakqist state, the situation is fluid, and it could get bad enough to force a reaction,

No, I will not permit Rosenmarkke to enter this conflict, if it escalates, replied Consantin firmly, The Assembly would never agree to it either, we must focus on the stability of shipping and trade, 

I agree, which is why the SCSID suggests that Rosenmarkke keep an eye on the events, but remains neutral in this instance, until the point where the ULR sustains a direct attack from the Irakqist regime, replied Menkin.

So then why bother us, if that is what you were going to say, replied Belgarde tersely.

It is merely my job, your honour, replied Menkin bowing.

Very well, it is agreed then that Rosenmarkke will have no part in the Irakqist affair, good, dismissed general, stated Strømm rising from her seat.

The general bowed politely and then left the room. 
-----------__
